title: When more measurement is not more evidence

conceptual_spine.stance: Ecological and evolutionary measurement design should be organized around the flow of distinctions required by the claim, not around data volume alone.
conceptual_spine.operational_rule: Before collecting more data, ask what distinction the next measurement must create or preserve for the conclusion to change.

cross_domain_structure.box_2: metabarcoding design example for timely preservation and failure diversity
cross_domain_structure.reason: avoid making the Opinion read as a synthesis of one island-pollination research programme
